summary: Shared EditUserModal mini-project — tested backend (5/5 pytest passing) + frontend E2E via Playwright on both People & Usage and Structure tabs of /organisation. Confirmed all field-parity fixes (Team dropdown now on Structure-tab modal, MFA toggle now on People-tab modal for admin/manager, MFA hidden for attendee) work correctly, save+persistence+re-open round-trips correctly, password validation still gates <10 chars, org/structure remains healthy. Found ONE bug: cross-tab cache sync is only half-wired — invalidateCache is called but PeopleHub does not reload when a save happens on the embedded Structure tab.

integration_issues.flow: Cross-tab cache sync (Structure-tab save → People-tab stale)
integration_issues.issue: When Edit User is saved from the Structure tab (embedded OrgStructure), the shared EditUserModal calls invalidateCache('/admin/users','/org/structure','/admin/people-stats') and OrgStructure's onUserSaved runs refreshData() — but PeopleHub's people state (from /admin/people-stats) is NOT re-fetched. Switching back to the People & Usage tab still shows the stale team name for the edited user (e.g. Demo User moved ONE→TWO on Structure tab still shows 'ONE' in People tab table) until the user clicks the manual Refresh button. Symmetric direction (People-tab save → Structure) works because OrgStructure re-mounts on tab switch (conditional render) whereas PeopleHub's people state is at the parent level and only load()'s on mount / manual refresh. Explicitly one of the acceptance criteria in the review request.

action_items: Fix cross-tab sync: in PeopleHub.js, expose a way to trigger `load()` after a save that happens inside the embedded <OrgStructure/>. Cleanest fix: pass an `onUserChanged` prop into <OrgStructure embedded onUserChanged={load} /> and have OrgStructure call it inside its `onUserSaved` (in addition to refreshData). Alternative: subscribe PeopleHub to a lightweight window event dispatched by EditUserModal on save (e.g. `window.dispatchEvent(new Event('users-updated'))`) so any listener refreshes. Third option: switch PeopleHub's data fetch to react-query with automatic revalidation on cache invalidation.
critical_code_review_comments: EditUserModal.js: `cachedGet('/org/structure')` is fired inside a useEffect with empty deps — if the modal mounts before the org/structure network request completes, the Team dropdown momentarily shows only the placeholder option. Not a functional bug (dropdown fills in ~200ms), but consider skeleton state or default value binding via useMemo.

EditUserModal.js line 71: PATCH `/org/users/{userId}/assign-team` runs conditionally when selectedTeam changes, but if the PUT/reset-password succeeds and this PATCH fails, cache is not invalidated (the invalidateCache line is after the try body's happy path but before the catch). Consider putting invalidateCache in a `finally` block or after each individual call so partial success still refreshes caches.

EditUserModal.js: `person.team_id` — PeopleHub rows key on `user_id`, and /admin/people-stats returns `team_id` (verified). Structure-tab rows key on `id`. Both handled correctly, but a small comment on the modal noting the two shape sources would help future readers.

OrgStructure.js openEditUser: uses `allUsers.find(au => au.id === u.id) || u` — falls back to the trimmed structure object if the user isn't in allUsers (e.g. race on initial load). The trimmed object lacks `mfa_enabled` → MFA toggle would default to false silently. Low risk, but log/refresh if not found.

The only outstanding bug is a data-refresh gap between PeopleHub and its embedded <OrgStructure>: saves inside Structure tab do not trigger PeopleHub's /admin/people-stats re-fetch. rca of the issue: Cross-tab sync gap RCA: PeopleHub.js keeps `people` in local state, populated by `load()` (calls cachedGet /admin/people-stats) in a useEffect on mount. The Structure sub-tab is rendered via `<OrgStructure embedded />` inside PeopleHub's conditional render, so it mounts/unmounts on tab switch, but PeopleHub itself does not remount. When the shared EditUserModal saves from within OrgStructure, it invalidates the /admin/people-stats cache and OrgStructure's onUserSaved re-fetches /admin/users + /org/structure — but nothing tells the parent PeopleHub to re-run load(). Consequently, on switching back to the People tab, PeopleTab re-renders with the pre-edit `people` array and shows stale team names. Reproduction: (1) login admin, (2) Structure tab → edit Demo User → change Team ONE→TWO → Save, (3) click People & Usage tab, (4) assert Demo User's Team column reads 'TWO' — actually reads 'ONE'. Mitigation: propagate a callback prop (`onUserChanged`) from PeopleHub down to embedded OrgStructure, invoke inside its onUserSaved.
